text.en:
Widows’ and Orphans’ Pension Act
(Chapter 350, Section 2)
Appointment of Directors
N 2
G.N. No. S 39/1964
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[21st February 1964]
The Minister for Finance has, under section 2 of the Widows’ and Orphans’ Pension Act, appointed the following persons to be Directors to carry out the provisions of the Act:
The Solicitor-General (Chairman);
The Deputy Secretary, Ministry of Finance; and
The Deputy Secretary, Ministry of Community Development.
